justification: GSTA-861 deterministic no-loss replay, no paid run (CREW rule 15): lib/review-depth.ts changes two stop-reason strings only, renaming the recovery command in the read-only final review's PR_ROUND_CAP reason and in CAPTAIN_DECIDES from 'run /ship again' to 'run /gstack-ship again' (#4819 leftovers). No step, dispatch, reader, effort, depth rule or History field changes, and no reviewer brief reads these strings. The GST-3562 replays (test/review-depth.test.ts, test/review-depth-lean.test.ts, test/review-risk-token-paths.test.ts) keep every case's kind and step at this file's bytes, because their kind rules match the unchanged reason prefixes ('a fix followed the read-only final review', 'read-only final review (R51)').
